svg.title: Packet flow and P4 queue-based holding
svg.desc: The master and outstation exchange requests, acknowledgments and responses through a P4 switch. Ingress classifies packets, arms request deadlines and selects queues. Internal blocker packets have priority over held packets. ACK and response queues share one scheduler; OPERATE uses another. Both internal loopback paths bypass egress and return to ingress for blocker expiry checks or forwarding released packets through normal egress.
